headlines.title: Homer City Generation Announces Delivery of First Two GE Vernova 7HA.02 Natural Gas Turbines
headlines.summary: INDIANA COUNTY, Pa., November 17, 2026--Homer City Generation, L.P., today announced that the delivery and setting of the first two of seven total GE Vernova 7HA.02 natural gas turbines to the Homer City Energy Campus were completed in late September 2026. The turbines are the first two of seven high-efficiency 7HA.02 natural gas turbines that GE Vernova is supplying to the campus, which will generate up to 4.4 gigawatts (GW) of power once complete.

headlines.title: Aegis Congratulates SEETEL on GE Vernova and SK On Partnership, and Receives First Payment on 14 Unit GGV Energy Order
headlines.summary: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Aegis Critical Energy Defence Corp. (CSE: QESS) (OTCQB: QESSF) (FSE: JG6) ("Aegis" or the "Company") is pleased to congratulate its manufacturing partner SEETEL New Energy Co., Ltd. on a new strategic partnership with GE Vernova of the United States and SK On of South Korea, and to confirm that it received the first payment this week on a 14 unit battery energy storage order from GGV Energy, its United States channel partner.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
